8.5.4 Mirror_ReportFlexRayChannelStatus
[SWS_Mirror_01025] Definition of callback function Mirror_ReportFlexRayChannelStatus ⌈
Service Name
Mirror_ReportFlexRayChannelStatus
Syntax
void Mirror_ReportFlexRayChannelStatus (
uint8 clusterId,
uint16 channelAStatus,
uint16 channelBStatus
)
Service ID [hex]
0x53
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different clusterIds. Non reentrant for the same clusterId.
clusterId
FlexRay cluster for which the status is reported.
channelAStatus
Status of FlexRay channel A.
Parameters (in)
channelBStatus
Status of FlexRay channel B.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Reports the aggregated channel status for FlexRay channels A and B of a cluster. The status is
encoded as specified in [SWS_Fr_00558].
Available via
Mirror.h
⌋
